metadata.title: COSU Digital Signage Endpoint SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining Corporate-Owned Single-Use (COSU) Digital Signage endpoints as display-only execution environments for institutional communications.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: A corporate-owned, single-use endpoint dedicated exclusively to rendering approved digital signage, announcements, and wayfinding content with no interactive or general-purpose computing capability.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: COSU Digital Signage endpoints inherit foundational endpoint trust governance from the Secure Endpoint Platform SSPP.

props.name: endpoint-class
props.remarks: Single-use COSU endpoint for display-only institutional messaging.

props.name: execution-model
props.remarks: Execution is restricted to a locked digital signage player or rendering service; no user interaction or application switching is permitted.

props.name: user-authentication-model
props.remarks: Digital Signage endpoints do not support interactive user authentication.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: Digital Signage endpoints are owned by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: Digital Signage endpoints are centrally enrolled, managed, and monitored.

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: Device identity is used for management, integrity validation, and content delivery trust, not data entitlement.

props.name: baseline-hardening
props.remarks: Operating system configuration disables shell access, local input devices, removable media, local storage, and any non-signage software.

props.name: anti-tamper-controls
props.remarks: Controls prevent unauthorized content injection, application switching, and local manipulation of display output.

props.name: network-access-model
props.remarks: Network access is limited to approved content distribution services, management endpoints, and update repositories.

props.name: data-persistence
props.remarks: No persistent institutional data is stored locally beyond transient content caching.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Digital Signage endpoints may display only public, non-sensitive information.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: A highly locked display device does not imply trust as a workstation or eligibility for institutional data access.

props.name: availability-requirement
props.remarks: Digital Signage endpoints must prioritize uptime and rapid recovery to support institutional communications.

props.name: monitoring-and-integrity-signals
props.remarks: Device health, display status, content rendering, and tamper events are continuously monitored.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Digital Signage endpoints support rapid reset, automated reimage, and auditable retirement workflows.

system-implementation.remarks: COSU Digital Signage endpoints implement Secure Endpoint patterns with emphasis on integrity of displayed content, minimal attack surface, and high availability.

roles.title: Digital Signage Operations
roles.remarks: Responsible for deployment, content delivery integration, monitoring, and recovery of Digital Signage endpoints.

roles.title: Institutional Communications Governance
roles.remarks: Approves content distribution platforms, display use cases, and exception handling.

control-implementation.remarks: Digital Signage implementations may use specialized hardware or OS kiosk modes and are maintained as tightly controlled, versioned configuration artifacts aligned with this SSPP.
